newsitem.title: USA: Gunman gives up in shopping mall hostage drama.
newsitem.headline: Gunman gives up in shopping mall hostage drama.

text.p: A gunman surrendered on Friday after holding his former girlfriend hostage for eight hours in a beauty salon at a Chicago shopping mall, police said.
No one was seriously hurt during the standoff that began on Friday afternoon when Lorenzo Davis Jr. shot into the air and ordered people out of the busy Mario Tricochi Hair Salon & Spa.

Police said Davis gave up peacefully when he became convinced he would not be harmed. The shaken woman was taken to a hospital after spending eight hours holed up in a back room of the salon while police negotiated with her former boyfriend.
Davis had been arrested twice over the past five months for harassing the woman, who broke off their relationship earlier this year, police said.
Witnesses said panicked patrons rushed out of the beauty salon, some still wearing curlers and smocks, when Davis pulled out a gun while talking to the woman, who was a hairdresser at the salon.
"I went to grab my coat and blouse and when I came out he had the gun pointing at the ceiling," one woman said, adding she heard shots and then rushed to the exit along with other patrons.
Police cordoned off the area around the salon at the Old Orchard Shopping Centre, and customers continued shopping elsewhere in the outdoor suburban mall during the standoff.
